care_120.name: 120-day care plan
care_120.description: A check-in at D+30, D+60, D+90, then a review at D+120.

d30.label: D+30 · First check-in
d30.message: Hi {prénom}, it's been a month since we started working together. How is your routine going? Let's have a quick catch-up.

d60.label: D+60 · Progress check
d60.message: Hi {prénom}, two months already! How are you feeling? Any questions about your products?

d90.label: D+90 · Adjustments
d90.message: Hi {prénom}, three months together now. Do you have a moment this week to review and adjust if needed?

d120.label: D+120 · Review
d120.message: Hi {prénom}, it's time for our review and to plan what comes next together. Shall we set up a call?

start_30.name: 30-day onboarding

d7.label: D+7 · First days

d15.label: D+15 · Checking in
d15.message: Hi {prénom}, how have the last two weeks been? Have you found your rhythm?

d30.label: D+30 · First month review
d30.message: Hi {prénom}, it's been a month since you started! Let's have a quick check-in to see what works best for you.

partner_onboarding.name: Partner welcome, 30 days
partner_onboarding.description: For a new recruit: welcome, tools, first contacts, first customer, review.

d1.label: D+1 · Welcome
d1.message: Welcome to the team {prénom}! I’m happy to support you. I’ll call you in two days to show you the tools — reach out anytime before that.

d3.label: D+3 · Getting started with the tools
d3.message: Hi {prénom}, as planned: shall we go over your account, your online shop and the basics to get started?

d7.label: D+7 · Your contact list
d7.message: Hello {prénom}! Have you started your list of people to talk to about the products? We can go through it together and pick your first 5 contacts.

d14.label: D+14 · First customer
d14.message: Hi {prénom}, how are your first conversations going? Let’s review your first customer or first presentation.

d30.label: D+30 · Review and goals
d30.message: Well done {prénom}, one month already! Shall we book a moment to review and set your goals for next month?

order_import.title: Import orders
order_import.intro: Bring in your history from your brand back-office CSV export (doTERRA, Zinzino…). No automatic follow-up is created: these are past orders.
order_import.paste_placeholder: Paste the file content here (with the header row)

order_import.error_empty: Empty or unreadable file: check it has a header row and data.
order_import.error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
order_import.contact_hint: The customer is matched by email, then phone, then name. Duplicates (same order number, or same day and amount) are skipped.
order_import.no_followups_hint: Orders are added to history and figures (revenue, tracking). No follow-up is created.
order_import.done_skipped: {{count}} rows skipped (duplicates, incomplete or contacts not created)

lead_page.explain: Share this link in your bio, on social media or by message. Everyone who fills in the form lands in your contacts (prospect) with a “call back today” follow-up.
lead_page.inactive_hint: Page disabled: visitors see “page not found”.
lead_page.slug_hint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes (3 to 41 characters).
lead_page.slug_invalid: Invalid address: lowercase letters, numbers and dashes, at least 3 characters.
lead_page.slug_taken: This address is already taken, choose another one.
lead_page.default_intro: Leave me your details: I’ll get back to you quickly to answer your questions and advise you.
lead_page.error: Could not save. Please try again.
lead_page.pending_hint: {{count}} pending sign-up(s): the contact could not be created (free plan quota?).
lead_page.create_error: Could not create the contact (quota reached?).

lead_page.brand_note_general_multi: 🌐 General page: sign-ups arrive without a brand (you are in Multi-brand mode). Also create one page per brand with the tabs above.
lead_page.brand_note_single: 🏷 Sign-ups get your {{brand}} brand on their contact page (chosen in Settings → My brand).
lead_page.brand_note_none: Sign-ups arrive without a brand (Settings → My brand: Generic).
lead_page.not_created_yet: This page does not exist yet: fill in the fields below, then create it to get your link.
lead_page.reset_done: Default values restored: tap Save to apply them.
lead_page.delete_hint: The link will stop working. Contacts already created stay in your Contacts. You can create a page again anytime.

privacy.intro: Your account, your data: who can access it, from where, and how to get it back or erase it.
privacy.password_desc: At least 8 characters. Change it if you think someone saw it.
privacy.mfa_desc: A 6-digit code from your phone (Google Authenticator, 1Password…) on top of your password.
privacy.mfa_scan: Scan this QR code with your app, then enter the code it shows.
privacy.mfa_disable_confirm: Your account will only be protected by your password. Turn it off anyway?
privacy.devices_desc: Devices you recently signed in from.
privacy.devices_signed_out: Other devices have been signed out.
privacy.support_desc: Oryalis support never sees your data without your consent. Each request states the reason, what would be viewed and for how long; you can refuse or cut access at any time. Every access is logged.
privacy.export_desc: Contacts, appointments, follow-ups, orders… as Excel or JSON.
privacy.delete_desc: All your data will be permanently erased, 30 days after the request.
privacy.delete_warning: Your contacts, appointments, follow-ups and orders will be permanently erased. Export your data first. You can cancel for 30 days.
privacy.delete_requested: Request saved. You can cancel it for 30 days.
privacy.delete_pending_desc: Your account and data will be erased on {{date}}. Until then, everything works as usual.
privacy.delete_cancelled: Deletion cancelled, your account is kept.
privacy.delete_unavailable: Online deletion is coming soon. Meanwhile, contact support.
